text:
Jordan: FYI CI started failing after we flipped to CUDA 12.2 for the new kernel set. Link errors about PTX version mismatch and fatbin size jumped ~9MB. Anyone seen this?
Leila: saw same on my local. It's the `-gencode` list shipping in the matrix — 12.2 maps PTX versions differently. `nvcc` emits ptxas warnings. 
Sam: which job? the `cuda-12.2` matrix one? We had one job that adds `-arch=compute_80` by mistake. Example we run:
```
nvcc -O3 -gencode arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 -gencode arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 -lineinfo -Xptxas -v -o out.o kernel.cu
```
Leila: yeah that `-arch` vs `-gencode` mix can produce unexpected PTX blobs. Also note NVCC might emit PTX v7 vs v8 depending on toolkit, which increases fatbin if both are embedded.
Maria: On CI I also noticed the container's gcc is 11 while locally we build with 12 — ABI differences change symbol sizes, causing our size gate to trigger. The job log: `fatbin: 13.1MB -> 22.4MB`
devops-bot: Build 1923456789/cuda-12.2 failed — step `link-kernels` — ptx mismatch. See https://ci.internal/build/1923456789
Jordan: short-term proposal: normalize build flags across matrix and add a CI step to canonicalize PTX subset and run a strict size delta check. Something like:
```
# normalize gencode list
export GENCODES="compute_75,code=sm_75;compute_80,code=sm_80"
nvcc ... -gencode ${GENCODES}
# then strip symbols we don't need
objcopy --remove-section=.nvFatBinSegment build/kernel.fatbin || true
```
Sam: ok for short-term. For medium-term we should: 1) pin toolkit minor (12.2) per runner, 2) add a canonical PTX-only build so runtime can choose sm vs ptx at load, 3) implement a size-gate that ignores known symbol tables.
Leila: I can open an RFC follow-up for CI changes and a small patch to the build matrix. Will also add the `ptxas` verbose output to the artifacts so we can see mapping.
Maria: +1 — will test on the `cuda-12` runner tomorrow and report.
Jordan: sweet. @devops-bot can you requeue the failing job after we push the flags patch? :thumbsup:
devops-bot: requeued job 1923456789/cuda-12.2 as 1923456901
ci-bot: build 1923456901 queued on `cuda-12` runners
Sam: thanks — also add a script to diff `nm -S` outputs and fail only if delta > 20% to avoid noisy alerts.
Leila: noted. I'll PR the matrix change and the size diff script.
